{{Quote|I'm a simple man making his way through the galaxy. Like my father before me.|Boba Fett|<ref name="Chapter 14">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 14: The Tragedy}}</ref>}}
'''Boba Fett''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[crime lord]] and former [[bounty hunter]] whose career spanned [[Standard decade|decades]], from the [[Republic Era|fall]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] to the [[Battle of Endor|end]] of the [[Imperial Era|rule]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Originally code-named '''Alpha''', he was an unaltered [[Cloning|clone]] of the famed [[Mandalorian]] bounty hunter, [[Jango Fett]], who raised the boy as his son. Boba emulated his [[Parent|father]] and [[gene]]tic [[Clone template|donor]] by wearing a [[Boba Fett's armor|customized suit]] of [[Mandalorian armor]]. His personal [[starship]] was the ''[[Slave I]]'', a [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]] that once belonged to Jango. Trained in combat and martial skills from a young age, Fett was one of the most feared [[bounty]] hunters in [[the galaxy]] during the reign of [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]. He became a legend over the course of his career, which included contracts for both the Empire and the extensive criminal underworld. After living among the [[Tusken Raider]]s of [[Tatooine]] for a time, he [[Attack on Jabba's Palace (Boba Fett)|took over]] as [[Daimyo]] of [[Mos Espa]] during the [[New Republic Era|era]] of the [[New Republic]].

Boba was created on the [[Wild Space]] [[planet]] of [[Kamino]] as a result of an arrangement between the [[Sith Lord]] [[Dooku|Darth Tyranus]] and Jango Fett, a Mandalorian [[foundling]] who served as the template of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. Unlike the [[clone trooper]]s grown from Jango's [[DNA]], Jango regarded Boba as his son. In accordance with certain Mandalorian traditions, Boba was also considered a foundling by virtue of his descent from Jango, whose [[chain code]] documented his participation in the [[Great Clan Wars|Mandalorian Civil War]] and his ownership of the armor later inherited by Boba.<ref name="MandoVG"/> During the last [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Separatist Crisis]], Boba and Jango retreated to [[Geonosis]] where the latter was [[Death|killed]] in [[First Battle of Geonosis|battle]] by [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]]. Orphaned by Jango's death, Boba sought vengeance by attempting to assassinate Windu, although his [[Sabotage of the Endurance|plan]] proved unsuccessful. After serving [[time]] in [[prison]] on [[Coruscant]], Fett took up his late father's profession as a bounty hunter, [[Krayt's Claw|working alongside]] other [[Mercenary|mercenaries]], such as [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]], [[Dengar]], and [[Asajj Ventress]], while also notably apprenticing himself to his father's infamous brief protégée, [[Cad Bane]].

In the [[Proclamation of the New Order|aftermath]] of the [[Clone Wars]], Fett continued to make a name for himself while working for the [[gangster]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], as well as the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War]], the bounty hunter managed to track down [[Captain]] [[Han Solo]] to [[Bespin]] on a contract for the [[Galactic Empire]], hoping to deliver him to [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on Tatooine. During the journey, Fett stopped on the [[moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa]] in order to make sure Solo would survive his time in carbonite, but he lost the [[smuggler]] while he was away as part of the return of the [[Crimson Dawn]], kicking off the [[War of the Bounty Hunters]]. Ultimately, Fett regained Solo and delivered him to the impatient Jabba.

Fett tried to prevent Solo's [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], only to fall into the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] when the smuggler accidentally slammed a pole into the bounty hunter's [[jetpack]], causing it to malfunction. Although Fett survived his ordeal with the man-eating [[sarlacc]], his [[armor]] was sold to [[Cobb Vanth]] by [[Jawa]] [[scavenger]]s. Following a time in the company of a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|Tusken tribe]], Fett eventually regained his armor by tracking down and confronting the Mandalorian [[Mandalorian warrior|warrior]] [[Din Djarin]] on [[Tython]], who had taken Fett's armor from Vanth. After helping Djarin to [[Assault on Moff Gideon's cruiser|rescue]] the foundling [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] from the clutches of [[Moff]] [[Gideon]], the ex-bounty-hunter returned to Tatooine where he killed [[Bib Fortuna]] and claimed the late Jabba's [[throne]] as [[Daimyo]], with [[Fennec Shand]] by his side. Now the head of his own [[Fett gotra|gotra]], Fett intended to rule the territories of [[Mos Espa]] by winning the people's respect, though he would face several major challenges to his position owed to the two-facedness of mayor [[Mok Shaiz]] such as the [[The Twins|Twins]]' bid for power and the expansion of the [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s [[Spice merchant|spice trade]]. Ultimately, though, Fett overcame all obstacles - including a confrontation with his old mentor, Cad Bane - and emerged victorious with the help of his associates, gaining the appreciation and approval of Mos Espa's denizens.
